summary: Frontend E2E of iteration 3 features (photo upload, impact stories, solver signup, Jharkhand map, header regression). All 4 new features and regression checks pass. No console errors.

test_results.header_nav: All 6 nav testids present and navigate correctly
test_results.impact_page: 2 impact-story-card shown for deployed challenges (agri-004 + waste). Share button toast copied confirmed.
test_results.impact_conditional_render: jmib-demo-water-001 (stage 5, non-deployed) does NOT show impact-story-card; jmib-demo-agri-004 (deployed) DOES show it.
test_results.solver_signup: Create button disabled until name+type+>=1 category. Radix select for 'University' works. After selecting Water & Sanitation + Roads & Public Infrastructure, matched grid renders with 1 challenge (water-logging). Register-another resets to form.
test_results.jharkhand_map: jharkhand-map renders on /dashboard, clicking map-district-dhanbad and map-district-jamshedpur updates map-selected-panel correctly.
test_results.photo_upload: set_input_files on input-photo-upload produced photo-preview + remove-photo-button. Submitted successfully; challenge detail page shows challenge-photo element.
test_results.no_photo_submit: Submitting without a photo works and shows under-ministry-review-badge.

critical_code_review_comments: Solvers.jsx: matchesFor uses challenges list without filtering out already-deployed/completed challenges — 'open challenges' phrasing in success toast is slightly misleading but functional.
JharkhandMap.jsx: district match uses (c.district||'').includes(n.d) — Singhbhum districts (East/West) will match ambiguously with substring 'Singhbhum'; low priority as seed uses explicit values.
store.jsx: solvers state uses localStorage key jmib_solvers_v1 without a migration path (not an issue now, informational).
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage before test to ensure v4 seed loaded deterministically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration-3 features (photo upload with set_input_files, impact stories with conditional rendering, solver signup + auto-match, Jharkhand map) verified end-to-end via Playwright. localStorage key jmib_challenges_v4 loads seed with 2 deployed challenges. Solver category testids follow pattern solver-cat-<lowercase-alpha-only>.
